sloka: दत्तमासनमालभ्य भोजनेन निमन्त्रितः ।मातरम् राघवः किम्चित् प्रसार्य अन्जलिम् अब्रवीत् ॥२-२०-२५॥
transliteration: dattamāsanamālabhya bhojanena nimantritaḥ ।mātaram rāghavaḥ kimcit prasārya anjalim abravīt ॥2-20-25॥

translations.english: Invited (by Kausalya) to partake the food, Rama out of abashment only touched the seat provided to him and having stretched his folded palms spoke to his mother.
